8.description: "It's time to D D D-DUEL!" is now a daily quest.

0.description: Beginner's Book of Ascension (found throughout many ascension zones) now allows players to train spells up to level 20, from level 10.
Corrected an issue where level 70 Unguarded Souls were not interactable.

3.description: [Website/Store] If you have a character currently logged onto the game, an indicator will be visible on the realm selection page of the store for additional clarity.

4.description: Ignore System: After ignoring a player you will now also have the option to ignore ALL characters from ignored player. Navigate to your ignore list and right-click the players name you want to fully ignore and select ignore account.

Transmog System: You can now link transmog sets to specialization. Linking a set to a spec will apply the transmog set whenever you switch to that spec. Visit a Transmogrification NPC, select at set and choose "Assign spec".

0.description: Fixed an issue where keys that used to unlock mythic dungeons were saying they unlocked heroic dungeons. Heroic Dungeons no longer require a key to enter.
Fixed a issue where blue and green items were contributing too heavily to item level calculation, allowing undergeared players to queue for Mythic Dungeons.
Added a quick access button to reroll at level 1, when in wildcard mode.
Added a quick load build link on Character advancement (Requires Restart).
Pending Restart, you will have a similar button the very new, "Share Build" button for importing builds from links.
Added a counter to character advancement to display how many points you have in each specialization on the tab.
Added Reset All Spells and Reset All Talents to Character advancement.
Added visualization of Scrolls of Fortune and Scroll of Unlearning to Character advancement
Added Settings button to character advancement to toggle Quick Access Menus.
Added help buttons for new players on Character Advancement that adapt to what mode the player is in.
Added Share Build button to CAO
Added Tabs under CAO to navigate to collections and vice versa.
Corrected many stats on items that were incorrectly increased last update. Items will have the same stats they had 24 hours ago.
Reduced baseline Resilience by 5%.
All hunter and warlock pets now deal 5% reduced damage in PvP.
Hunter pet Stamina scaling has been decreased to 20%, from 30%.
Hunter pet base health has been increased by 15%.

5.description: Fixed an issue where some items had incorrect PvE power.
The heal from Idol of the Claw now has a 30% healing power scaling, changed from 48%.
Shockwave Truncheon is now a 3.6 Speed Weapon.
Staff of Infinite Mysteries is now a 3.6 Speed Weapon
Crystalfire Staff is now a 3.6 Speed Weapon.
Bloodmauw Magus Blade is now a 2.6 Speed Weapon.

[Mythic Itemization Changes] Avain Cloak of Feathers now have 10 Haste Rating
[Mythic Itemization Changes] Choker of Fluid Thought now has 12 Haste Rating.

a!changelog add fix live [Mythic Itemization Changes] Mana Wrath now has 10 Haste Rating.
[Mythic Itemization Changes] Runed Dagger of Solace now has 10 Haste Rating and no longer has PvP power in its heroic dungeon / mythic counterpart.

[Mythic Itemization Changes] Northshire Battlemace now has 10 Haste Rating.

Fixed some other miscellaneous issues with Mystic Enchantments as part of a larger overhaul of the system.

Mystic Enchantments are no longer entirely disabled en-masse because you broke the limit. The system will always prioritize the equipment that you equipped first (This guaranteed order only applies to items equipped after this update).
Mystic Enchantments now has personalized error reporting for different scenarios (stack limit vs. epic limit vs. legendary limit vs. etc.)
Fixed double reporting of Mystic Enchantment errors.

3.description: [Launcher] Fixed an issue where embedded videos could cause weird behavior if interacted with.
[Launcher] Updated the launcher framework to the latest version available for improved performance.
[Launcher] Added tutorial playlist for new players upon install.
[Launcher] Fixed an issue where the shop categories would not update when switching realm.
[Launcher] Added a progress indicator used to track update/repair/install progress when browsing various pages on the launcher.
[Launcher] Added a new post-checkout page to the launcher to bring coherency between web and launcher checkout experiences.
[Launcher] Fixed an issue where the cart would freeze if you attempted to checkout without a character selected.
[Launcher] Fixed an issue where shop items would align incorrectly when a non-even amount of items were present.
[Launcher] Fixed an issue where the shop categories would not update when switching realm.

7.description: Fixed a bug where Deathbringer dealt too high dmg versus players.
Controlled Burn no longer increases the cast time of Immolate.
Chilling Blows now extends the duration of Deep Freeze by 0.5 seconds, changed from 0.3 seconds.
Improved Mend now decreases the mana cost of your Mend Pet by 50%, from 15% but no longer gives it a chance to dispel any debuffs.

1.description: Maim is now an incapacitate effect instead of a stun effect. It will only break on non-periodic damage.
Increased the cooldown of Fel Domination to 5 minutes, changed from 3 minutes. In addition, its duration has been reduced to 5 seconds, changed from 15 seconds.
Natural Shapeshifter now reduces the global cooldown of Cat and Bear Form by 0.25/0.5 sec, changed from 0.5/1 sec.
While in a 1v1 arena, Bear Form and Dire Bear Form now increases stamina by 10%, changed from 20%.
Increased the stun duration of the Concussion Capstone to 3 seconds, up from 2.
Sap is now usable on Beasts, Demons and Dragonkins, in addition to Humanoids.
Repentance is now usable on all enemy types.
Fel Vitality now increases Stamina and Intellect of summoned demons by 10/20/30%, changed from 15/30/45%.
Wild Hunt (pet talent) now increases the contribution your pet gets from your Stamina by 15/30%, changed from 20/40%.
Great Stamina (pet talent) now increases health by 3/6/9%, changed from 4/8/12%.
Dive and Dash now lasts for 8 sec, down from 16. The speed increase is changed to 70%, from 80%.
Froststorm Breath now slows for 25%, changed from 40%.
Heart of the Phoenix now resurrects your pet with 25% health, changed from 100%.
Fixed a bug where using Shadowmeld in PvP combat did not make the player properly leave combat.
Claw now deals 10% less damage in PvP while Razor Claws is active.
Flame Shock now deals 30% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Insect Swarm now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Eviscerate (Disembowel) now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Shield Slam now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Rupture now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Lightning Bolt no longer deals reduced damage against players. It previously had a PvP modifier of 5%.
Immolate now deals 5% increased damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Ice Lash now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Holy Shock now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 25%.
Eviscerate now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Divine Storm (One with the Light) now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Crusader Strike (One with the Light) now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Crackling Thunder now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Chaos Bolt now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Chain Lightning now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Bloodthirst now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Bladestorm now deals 25% reduced damage against players, from 30%.
Backstab no longer deals reduced damage against players. It previously had a PvP modifier of 5%.
Arcane Shot now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 20%.

0.description: If you talk to a Transmogrifier with empty equipment slots, they will be filled with invisible items. These items can have transmogrifications applied to them and decay after leaving your equipment.
